items.title: Rank Math 恶意代码植入风险
items.title_zh: Rank Math 恶意代码植入风险
items.summary_zh: 环境中出现恶意 wp_options、隐藏 PHP 后门及未授权管理员账户，提示站点可能已被植入后门。
items.action_zh: 排查并清除后门，升级 Rank Math 至最新版并重置管理员凭据
items.impact_scope: WordPress 站点，易被植入后门
items.description: Rank Math SEO PRO for WordPress is affected by a supply-chain compromise in a subset of version 3.0.123 packages downloaded or updated between October 15, 2026 at 20:02 UTC and October 16, 2026 at 07:12 UTC. Rank Math identifies three malicious wp_options keys, hidden PHP backdoors, unauthorized administrator accounts, a fake WordPress core file, PHP-executable .cache files, and a system cron marker as incident indicators.

items.title: Craft CMS GraphQL 跨站越权
items.title_zh: Craft CMS GraphQL 跨站越权
items.summary_zh: 持有站点A的 GraphQL 令牌的攻击者可跨站指定 siteId 增删内容，导致越权篡改。
items.action_zh: 升级 Craft CMS 至 5.11.0 或更高版本
items.repro_note: 需站点A GraphQL令牌，跨站指定siteId增删内容
items.impact_scope: Craft CMS 多站点内容管理
items.description: Craft CMS from 5.0.0 before 5.11.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows site-scoped GraphQL tokens to mutate other sites' content because requireAllowedSite() is not enforced. Attackers holding a site-A token can create entries in site B via supplied siteId and delete entries, categories, tags, and assets shared across sites.

items.title: SLiMS 报表模块 SQL 注入
items.title_zh: SLiMS 报表模块 SQL 注入
items.summary_zh: 已登录管理员可通过 fileID 参数注入 SQL，读取或篡改数据库内容。
items.action_zh: 升级 SLiMS 修复版本；临时限制后台访问并过滤 fileID 参数
items.repro_note: 登录后台，向 dl_detail.php 的 fileID 参数注入
items.impact_scope: 图书馆管理系统后台数据
items.description: SENAYAN Library Management System (SLiMS) Bulian (slims9_bulian) 9.8.0 is vulnerable to SQL Injection in admin/modules/reporting/customs/dl_detail.php via the parameter fileID.

items.title: Cognition 沙箱未授权 RCE
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者可调用无鉴权的 REST/SSE API，触发本地沙箱执行任意代码。
cwe_labels: 初始化不安全(默认凭据)
items.action_zh: 升级至 0.13.0 及以上；为 API 增加认证并禁用本地沙箱
items.repro_note: 未授权访问 REST/SSE API，触发本地沙箱执行
items.impact_scope: AI Agent 沙箱，可能暴露公网
items.description: Cognition before 0.13.0 contains an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability due to defaulting its agent sandbox backend to local execution and shipping no authentication on its REST/SSE API. Attackers can create a session via POST /sessions and post a message via POST /sessions/{id}/messages without credentials, causing the Deep Agents ReAct loop to run attacker-directed shell commands through the local shell backend, resulting in remote code execution as the server process.

items.title: 未知组件 未授权资源耗尽
items.title_zh: 未知组件 未授权资源耗尽
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者可反复请求写入约560KB数据，耗尽磁盘或 APCu；低权账号可篡改翻译。
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；限制匿名请求及写入配额，监控 APCu 与磁盘
items.repro_note: 匿名请求触发约560KB存储写入，验证配额耗尽
items.impact_scope: Web 应用存储与缓存资源
items.description: Unauthenticated attackers can send small requests that each store about 560 KB to exhaust disk or APCu, while accounts with api.pages.write can overwrite translations or create pages that page-level rules deny.
